facts.text: Andrew and his girlfriend went fishing in a nearby lake last weekend and caught several fish.

evidence.quote: Last weekend my girlfriend and I went fishing in one of the nearby lakes. It was so nice. We got a few fish and had a blast.

evidence.quote: Have you ever gone fishing before?
I remember this moment a few years back when I sat by a gorgeous lake in the mountains with friends. So peaceful and calming.
